# こと vs の — the nominalizers

**[こと](<../grammar/こと.md>)**
:   Nominalizes a clause as an abstract fact or matter: 泳ぐことができる。Required in set patterns (ことができる・ことにする) and when the clause is the predicate — 趣味は泳ぐことです。The formal choice.

**[の (nominalizer)](<../grammar/の.md#nominalizer>)**
:   Wraps a clause as a concrete, live event — required with perception verbs (歌うのが聞こえる), usual with stopping (行くのをやめた)。The direct, conversational choice.
